description: Arceaux vélos is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Dijon métropole. A bicycle hoop is a type of furniture intended for bicycle parking. It is an object that allows to hold and attach a bicycle with an anti-theft by the frame and a wheel. The Arceau is usually sealed or bolted to the ground. Coverage: Dijon métropole. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle arches" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Dijon métropole. Its keywords include deplacements-et-mobilites. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, JSON, ZIP. The listing shows 2025-06-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
